title: Equal-audit corrected-protocol replication
scope: Output mapping and explanation consistency with identical deterministic audit assistance; six new paired synthetic fixtures
best_observed: mapping-contract, descriptive objective best in this cohort only
conclusion: Neither arm met all objective and original-explanation requirements. The mapping contract passed all six structured-answer checks but failed four explanation reviews. No accepted champion and no claim of general superiority.
correction_note: An initial review summary miscounted selected explanation passes as three; its per-case boolean decisions total two. The scientist corrected the aggregate without changing any per-case judgment.
next_step: Stop this exhausted cohort. A future proposal would improve explanation coverage while preserving equal assistance and strict acceptance; it is not executed.
historical_comparability: This six-case cohort is separate from the previous 24-request run and must not be joined into a continuous improvement curve.
